atAGlance: Mì xào chay is vegetarian stir-fried noodles, usually with egg noodles or wheat noodles, vegetables, tofu, garlic, and soy-lime vegetarian dip.
whatItIs: Mì xào chay is vegetarian stir-fried noodles with vegetables, tofu or mushrooms, garlic, scallions, and savory seasoning; some shops use egg noodles.
howToEnjoy: Eat hot while the noodles still have chew and the vegetables stay bright. Ask about egg noodles or fish sauce if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order mì xào chay and ask for no fish sauce or no egg noodles before the wok starts if needed. Ask for extra vegetables instead of extra seasoning.
worthKnowing: Xào means stir-fried, so this chay order is about wok heat, vegetables, and noodle texture rather than soup.
goodToKnow: Some vegetarian noodle orders still use egg noodles or egg; ask if you need it vegan.
travelerCaution: Ask about egg noodles, egg, and fish sauce if strict.
